newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Republic in joint U.S. venture - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Republic in joint U.S. venture - paper.

text.p: Republic Ratings, a local debt-rating agency, has entered a joint venture with U.S.-based international rating agency Duff & Phelbs Credit Rating (DCR), a local newspaper reported on Monday.
DCR had bought a 40 percent stake in Republic for an undisclosed sum, said Dave King, Republic's managing director.
Republic would change its name to Duff & Phelbs Credit Rating Company of Southern Africa, Business Report said.
Republic's new partner, DCR, is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and claims to be the world's largest international rating network, spanning 15 countries, the paper said.
